cases.title: T081 (A only): after "it didn't work" the learner says yes to going deeper on the pivot step. A skill a step was tagged with starts the lesson even when the answer didn't offer it: go_deeper is never refused, the hand-over is silent, and the pivot lesson opens on Shake Control

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor writes nothing before the lesson speaks, names no command or skill ID, and the lesson opens on Shake Control with one goal sentence and the pivot lesson's first ask: "We're working on Shake Control, so the shake turns from where the hammer hits. Select Shake Control in the timeline and press A, then Shift+P, so Anchor Point and Position both show."

Turn 2 reports only what the fresh read shows ("Nothing changed since my last read", Shake Control's Position "still where it was"), names what it didn't read ("I can't read the pivot directly"), and marks the cause as a hint ("That hints the drag may have moved a different layer's pivot"); it gives no verdict and no Undo, then ends on retrying step 3 with one offer to go deeper on that step.
